summary: Oruka Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting preliminary cash of ~$496M as of March 31, 2026 (Item 2.02) and entry into an underwriting agreement on April 28, 2026 for a primary public offering of 9,660,000 shares at $72.50/share, with a 30-day greenshoe option for up to 1,449,000 additional shares (Item 8.01). Underwriters include Leerink, TD Securities, Goldman Sachs, Stifel, and Guggenheim. No special-situation M&A, activism, restructuring, or other event; it is a routine equity capital raise disclosed via 8-K. Watch for closing and share dilution.
